einzeiler: Comedian Jeremiah Watkins discusses his new special, impressions, and morning talk shows.
kurzfassung: Comedian Jeremiah Watkins joins the podcast to discuss his new stand-up special, Crazy Pizza, recorded in Illinois. The conversation covers vintage radio ventriloquism, classic comedy impressions, and critiques of daytime television like The View. Later, the hosts review recent political media appearances and news stories from Southern California.
stichpunkte: Jeremiah Watkins discusses the release and production of his comedy special, Crazy Pizza.
The hosts explore the history of early radio ventriloquism with Edgar Bergen and Charlie McCarthy.
Jeremiah shares his approach to testing intimate material in his stand-up acts without alienating family.
Jay Moore's parody character Andrew Dice Gay is featured and discussed.
The group analyzes Dave Chappelle's stage presence and smoking habits during performances.
A detailed discussion breaks down sandwich-making as a therapeutic ritual for men.
The hosts mock Whoopi Goldberg and the panel on The View over their coverage of Sydney Sweeney.
Norm Macdonald's memorable appearance on The View and an old anecdote about him are recalled.
Rudy Povich presents the news, covering Gavin Newsom, minibike street takeovers, and Ilhan Omar.

kapitel.titel: Discussing Comedy Specials and Intimacy in Stand-Up
Andrew Dice Gay and Comedic Impressions
The Sandwich as Therapy for Men
Critique of The View and Sydney Sweeney Backlash

clips.hook: Listening to stand-up comedy instead of watching it
clips.text: Going on a long walk while listening to a comedy special through earbuds offers a surprisingly engaging way to consume the material.

beschreibung:
Jeremiah Watkins is a Los Angeles-based stand-up comedian, actor, and podcast host known for his high-energy performances. He gained widespread recognition as a member of ‘Roast Battle’ and by creating ‘Stand Up On The Spot.’ Check out his new special ‘Crazy Pizza’ out now on his YouTube channel, @jeremiahwatkins.
IN THE NEWS: Gavin Newsom faces online criticism over a fly-fishing interview with CNN’s Jake Tapper, where he said he would not run for president in 2028 if Kamala Harris enters the race. LAPD stops a group of roughly 70 minibike riders on Los Angeles’ 6th Street Bridge. Rep. Ilhan Omar says she has “nothing to apologize for” over her comments about Charlie Kirk and argues that there is “no legacy to honor.” President Trump criticizes previous administrations over the condition of the White House while highlighting his renovation efforts. Plus, Pete Buttigieg says he believes America is ready for a gay president.
